target_customer: Developers and teams building and running AI agents or AI workers that need persistent cloud desktops
problem: Agents that use computers need secure, persistent desktops they can see and control that keep running after logout; building and managing those environments is a burden for teams.
business_model: Usage and subscription plans for cloud desktops; the changelog lists paid plans at 29, 99 and 399 USD per month
product_category: Cloud computers and sandboxes for AI agents, developer infrastructure

founders.name: Spencer Kinney
founders.background_notes: YC page lists Z Fellow and JPMorgan; no education listed.

founders.name: Tiger Wang
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no prior employers.

competitors.name: E2B
competitors.what: Isolated Linux sandboxes for agent code execution, open source core with a paid hosted service
competitors.traction_then: A comparison reports 1 billion sandboxes run in total (date not stated)

competitors.name: Browserbase
competitors.what: Cloud headless browser infrastructure for agents

technical_complexity.rationale: Provisioning Linux virtual desktops in seconds with persistence, snapshots, an API and an MCP server is standard infrastructure engineering with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Many sandbox and cloud desktop vendors exist and hyperscalers can offer similar products; persistence and developer integrations are modest stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded sandbox vendors and clouds expanded agent computer offerings in 2025 and 2026; no direct action against Orgo is known.

market_need_then: Growth of computer-use agents created demand for persistent desktops; the company reports over 1000 teams using it by the Fall 2026 batch (self reported).

branding.domain_note: Uses orgo.ai; legal entity is Organic Intelligence, Inc.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short and developer focused: computers for agents

branding.community_and_virality: Covered in a Fondo blog post and listed on developer directories; no Hacker News launch or merch found.

brand_strength.rationale: A short distinctive name and a crisp tagline, though little press about the brand itself and other companies use similar names such as Orgo or Rogo.

outcome_analysis: Orgo is an Active Fall 2026 company with no outcome yet. It claims over 1000 teams using its cloud desktops and has paid plans, which suggests early product pull. The category is crowded with funded sandbox vendors and cloud platforms, so differentiation on persistence and ease of use will matter. No acquisition or shutdown news was found.
notes: Crunchbase entries for Orgo are placeholders and a Crunchbase Orgo.ai profile describes an unrelated hospital scheduling company; ignored. Bouncewatch lists 225K USD of grant and assistance entries with no investors, unclear match, not recorded. Founded year 2025 comes from the company about page. Competitor source dates are 2026 comparisons and approximate. No exact dated competitor launch pages were opened.
